## Map 1 — Fort Overview (Reference) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `s2_fort_overview.html` (+ `s2_fort_overview.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S2_Chieftains_Price/`

**Scenes:** Pre-session orientation — show to players before Scene 0. Do not reveal tactical details.

Full fort layout at overview scale: walls, gates, towers, interior buildings. Good for establishing where the north wall and west gate are before combat begins.

| Token file | Who | Note |
|---|---|---|
| — | — | Reference only. No combat tokens. |

## Map 2 — North Approach (Reference) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `s2_approach_north.html` (+ `s2_approach_north.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S2_Chieftains_Price/`

**Scene:** Scene 0 (Cold Open) — outside the north wall, alarm fires on the horizon

Sextus is dead here. Place his token prone on the rampart walk. Alarm fires glow on the hill. Use briefly — transition to north wall battle map when combat begins.

| Token file | Who | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Scout.rptok` | Sextus (dead sentry) | x1 — place prone on wall walk, Scene 0 only |
| `Guard.rptok` | Wall guards (alarmed) | x2 |

## Map 3 — North Wall (Battle Map) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `s2_north_wall.html` (+ `s2_north_wall.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S2_Chieftains_Price/`

**Scene:** Scene 3 Phase 1 — Germanic raid, wall defense

22×14 square battle grid (60px/sq = 5 ft.). Towers at each end, crenelated parapet. Raiders attack from outside using ladders; defenders hold the rampart walk.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Guard.rptok` | Fort legionaries | x4 — on wall walk |
| `Tribal_Warrior.rptok` | Germanic raiders | x8 — outside at ladder base, arriving turn 2 |
| `Berserker.rptok` | Germanic berserker | x2 — lead climbers |
| `Centurion_Varro.rptok` | Centurion Varro | x1 — commanding east tower |

## Map 5 — West Gate (Battle Map) {.unnumbered}

**File:** `s2_west_gate.html` (+ `s2_west_gate.jpg`)

**Path:** `Maptool/maps/campaign/S2_Chieftains_Price/`

**Scene:** Scene 3 Phase 2 — West Gate Breach

Switch from north wall map when the alarm horn sounds from the west. Vercingetorix's main force hits the gate while the wall party is still occupied.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Tribal_Warrior.rptok` | Germanic raiders | x8 — battering at gate exterior |
| `Berserker.rptok` | Germanic berserker | x2 — lead assault |
| `Guard.rptok` | Gate defenders | x4 — inside, holding barricade |

Then Phase 3: Vercingetorix enters through the breach. Switch to `CastleWallPublicJPG.jpg` for the wider courtyard view.

| Token file | Who | Count / Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Vercingetorix_the_Red.rptok` | Vercingetorix | x1 — enters through breach |
| `Tribune_Lucius.rptok` | Tribune Lucius | x1 — appears immaculate in courtyard |
| `Praetorian_Guard.rptok` | Tribune's escort | x6 — flanking Lucius |

## Road Encounters (d8) — Optional {.unnumbered}

After Scene 4, if the party leaves the fort heading south. Roll d8 once per 4 hours of travel.

| d8 | Encounter | Map file |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Abandoned shrine — 3 dead travelers, no wounds, scorch marks (vault corruption) | `RoadAltar.jpg` |
| 2 | Shadow in the ditch — DC 13 Perception; 1 Shadow attacks at dusk | `RockyRoad-Public.jpg` |
| 3 | Tribune's outriders — 4 cavalry checking travel papers | `CrossroadsPublic.jpg` |
| 4 | Gallic merchant caravan — info broker opportunity | `RiversideVillagePublic.jpg` |
| 5 | Ambushed by bandits (3 + captain) | `ForestBanditCampPublic.jpg` |
| 6 | Cultist of Mars patrol (1 Berserker + 2 Cultists) | `ForestPathPublic.jpg` |
| 7 | Small farm — shelter, fresh food, rumor of Germanic movements | `SmallFarmPublic.jpg` |
| 8 | Mountain pass — nothing happens; add atmosphere only | `MountainPassPublic.jpg` |

All road map files are in `Maptool/maps/campaign/S2_Chieftains_Price/`.

| Token file | Scene | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `Shadow.rptok` | Enc 2 | 1× shadow — keep invisible until dusk triggers |
| `Cultist_of_Mars.rptok` | Enc 6 | x2 flanking |
| `Berserker.rptok` | Enc 6 | x1 lead attacker |
| `Bandit.rptok` | Enc 5 | x3 |
| `Bandit_Captain.rptok` | Enc 5 | x1 |

## Handouts — Print Before Session {.unnumbered}

| File | Give when | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `handouts/handout_04_tribunes_orders.html` | Scene 1 — Tribune presents credentials | Let a player break the wax seal aloud |
| `handouts/handout_05_encoded_letter.html` | Scene 2 — players search Tribune's quarters | Hand it folded. Say nothing. Shift 3. |

Open each HTML file in browser, Ctrl+P to print. Standalone — no internet needed after fonts load.
